source: OpenAI press release: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available: built with GPT-6 Luna, it answers bounded-answer questions (probability, choice or score) from text, images and structured inputs up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API, takes up to 400 questions per request, has a native GPT-Live integration and US / EU inference residency, and costs $0.10 per million input tokens ($0.01 cached) with no output-token charges. Customers quoted in the release include Box, Datadog, Ramp, Sierra and Speak.
quarterly_data.figure: $0.10 per million input tokens; up to 10x faster
